question: Which of the following countries produced the maximum amount of sugarcane, according to Food and Agriculture Organization, in the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Brazil.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Brazil** is the biggest sugarcane manufacturing country in the world followed by India, China and Thailand. Brazil makes around 768 million tonnes of sugarcane annually.
